Hide KVM's pt_mode module param behind CONFIG_BROKEN
for virtualizing Intel PT via guest/host mode unless BROKEN=y.  There are
myriad bugs in the implementation
column2: some of which are fatal to the guest

column1: and others which put the stability and health of the host at risk.
For guest fatalities
column2: the most glaring issue is that KVM fails to ensure

column1: tracing is disabled
necessary as hardware disallows loading (the guest's) RTIT_CTL if tracing
is enabled (enforced via a VMX consistency check).  Per the SDM:
If the logical processor is operating with Intel PT enabled (if
IA32_RTIT_CTL.TraceEn = 1) at the time of VM entry
IA32_RTIT_CTL"" VM-entry control must be 0.
On the host side
column2: KVM doesn't validate the guest CPUID configuration

column1: provided by userspace
decide what MSRs to save/load at VM-Enter and VM-Exit.  E.g. configuring
guest CPUID to enumerate more address ranges than are supported in hardware
will result in KVM trying to passthrough
which generates a variety of WARNs
deadlock
